title: Produce in motion

location.extent: Complete local video; PNG is first-frame poster

slide_intent: Keep identification stable while imagery moves so viewers can enjoy sensory detail without losing the source.
strategic_value: The fixed vivid wordmark can remain recognizable amid Sweetgreen’s drifting ingredients.
demonstration: A bright wordmark stays centered while close-up pieces of produce move through shallow focus against a warm background.
practical_value: Compare a stationary signature with moving foreground ingredients when planning a short brand loop.

content_islands.name: Signature
content_islands.spec: Hold the small wordmark at the center.

content_islands.name: Moving produce
content_islands.spec: Let colorful ingredients pass around and across the field at different depths.

reference_purposes.Expression: The complete clip pairs a fixed wordmark with floating, shifting-focus produce.
